name: Sarah M.
text: This is so helpful! We just got a labradoodle and I had no idea they were prone to ear infections. Already scheduled a vet appointment to learn proper cleaning techniques.

name: Marcus T.
text: Great article but I think you undersold the hip dysplasia risk. My goldendoodle needed surgery at 3 years old and it was expensive. Definitely get health screening before buying.

name: Jennifer K.
text: Has anyone else dealt with food allergies in their doodles? My cockapoo itches constantly and we're still figuring out which foods trigger it.

name: David L.
text: Appreciate the preventative care tips. Prevention is definitely cheaper than treatment, especially with these breeds that seem prone to everything.

name: Rachel G.
text: My labradoodle is 7 years old and healthy as can be. I think a lot of this depends on getting from a reputable breeder who health tests their parents.
